title: Make portfolio claims actually exclusive
problem: The portfolio contract says active claims deduplicate execution, but claim files are created under worker-unique names. Two workers can therefore observe no claim and both successfully create different files for the same job/dedupe key. This happened on portfolio-tts-find-existing-tool: CLAIM-WC-SOL-20260917T174730Z.json and CLAIM-WC-20260917T144753-0300-SOL56.json both grant overlapping active claims for dedupe_key tool:tts:recover-existing:v1.
mission: Harden portfolio acquisition so execution authority is won through one deterministic create-if-absent pin per job/dedupe key, while preserving append-only per-attempt evidence and terminal-return dedupe. Add a race canary proving exactly one winner under concurrent acquisition.
acceptance: A deterministic exclusive pin path is derived from portfolio job_id or dedupe_key and acquired with create-if-absent before substantive work.
A two-worker same-job race yields exactly one execution-authority winner even when both start from the same observed state.
The loser persists append-only attempt evidence and immediately reallocates instead of working the duplicate job.
Existing immutable historical claims are not deleted or rewritten.
Terminal return for the dedupe_key still blocks replay after claim expiry.
Portfolio Worker Contract and /wc bootstrap describe the same acquisition law, with an automated fixture/canary preventing regression.
expected_compounding_value: HIGH: every surplus /wc worker uses this gate; fixing it prevents duplicate project work and makes the new portfolio fallback measurable under concurrency.
falsification: Two workers can still acquire execution authority for the same dedupe_key by creating different claim filenames.
The proposed pin serializes unrelated portfolio jobs.
A loser can overwrite or revoke the winner.
Historical claim evidence must be deleted to make the mechanism work.
Terminal returns can be replayed after the pin expires.
dedup_note: The existing live-claim-attempt receipt proposal addresses durability of race outcomes for the universal claim fabric; this proposal is narrower and distinct: portfolio acquisition currently permits multiple successful authority-bearing claims for one dedupe_key because exclusivity is not anchored to a single path.
